review_protocol: A finding is confirmed only when the mutated execution completes, the task prompt explicitly requires the changed or missing effect, and source inspection shows why the task oracle accepts it.

confirmed_current_defects.missing_requirement: a new recurring iPhone subscription payment
confirmed_current_defects.cause: the oracle accepts a pre-existing Spotify schedule through a broad subject match
confirmed_current_defects.repair: require exactly one new scheduled transaction with the expected recipient, amount, subject, date, and recurring flag

confirmed_current_defects.missing_requirement: send the additional VAT amount to Apple
confirmed_current_defects.cause: the oracle checks only the amount of any transaction
confirmed_current_defects.repair: require exactly one new transaction and validate recipient, amount, subject, date, and recurring flag

confirmed_current_defects.missing_requirement: invite Dora using the email found on her website
confirmed_current_defects.cause: the post-state stores the username but not the invite email, and the oracle checks only the username
confirmed_current_defects.repair: validate the invite email from the executed call trace as well as the post-state user

confirmed_current_defects.surviving_mutation: replace the recipient list with an empty list
confirmed_current_defects.missing_requirement: email the recommendation to the user's wife
confirmed_current_defects.cause: the oracle validates the new email's subject and body but not its recipients
the oracle validates description and times but omits the title

known_prior_art_not_claimed.status: independently reproduced and fixed in the patch, but excluded from new findings

reviewed_not_promoted.reason: the call appends request telemetry, but the requested final effect still occurs after deletion

unreviewed_candidate_policy: Raw surviving argument mutations are not called defects. Many fields are intentionally unconstrained or contain reference placeholders; only the five cases above are promoted.
